STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_08062_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_08062_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_08062(output reg [9:0] A, input wire clk);
    parameter I = 8-1, S = 16-1, R = 32, C = 32, R_M = 30, C_M = 30, obj = 10;
    
    integer flag_data_read = 1, flag_conv = 0, flag_max = 0, flag_final = 0, flag_prob = 0;
    integer i, j, k, r = 0, it = 0, max, t = 0;
    integer max_value = 2500, th = 200, alpha = 1;
    integer count = 0;
    integer image_count = -2, weights_count = -2, bias_count = -2, filter_count = -2;
    
    reg signed [I:0] Image[0:R*C-1];
    reg signed [S:0] Filters[0:obj-1];
    reg signed [S:0] Conv[0:R_M*C_M-1];
    reg signed [S:0] MP[0:((R_M*C_M)/4)-1];
    reg signed [S:0] Weights[0:((R_M*C_M)/4)*obj-1];
    reg signed [S:0] Bias[0:obj-1];
    reg signed [S:0] Final[0:obj-1];
    reg signed [S:0] sum = 0, temp = 0;
    
    reg signed [S:0] K1, K2, K3, K4, K5, K6, K7, K8, K9;
    reg signed [S:0] fb;
    
    reg [I:0] image_value;
    reg [S:0] bias;
    reg [S:0] filters;
    reg [S:0] weights;
    
    reg [31:0] address_image = 0;
    reg [31:0] address_weight = 0;
    reg [31:0] address_bias = 0;
    reg [31:0] address_filter = 0;

    // Dummy memory logic used to replace external modules
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        image_value <= Image[address_image];
        weights <= Weights[address_weight];
        bias <= Bias[address_bias];
        filters <= Filters[address_filter];
    end
    
    always @(posedge clk)
    if (flag_data_read) begin
        if (count < 1026) begin
            if (image_count > -1) begin
                Image[image_count] = image_value;
            end
            if (address_image < 1024)
                address_image = address_image + 1;
            else
                address_image = 0;
        end
        
        if (count < 2252) begin
            if (weights_count > -1) begin
                Weights[weights_count] = weights;
            end
            if (address_weight < 2250)
                address_weight = address_weight + 1;
            else
                address_weight = 0;
        end
        
        if (count < 12) begin
            if (bias_count > -1) begin
                Bias[bias_count] = bias;
            end
            if (address_bias < 10)
                address_bias = address_bias + 1;
            else
                address_bias = 0;
        end
        
        if (count < 12) begin
            if (filter_count > -1) begin
                Filters[filter_count] = filters;
            end
            if (address_filter < 10)
                address_filter = address_filter + 1;
            else
                address_filter = 0;
        end
        
        if (count < 2253) begin
            count = count + 1;
            image_count = image_count + 1;
            filter_count = filter_count + 1;
            bias_count = bias_count + 1;
            weights_count = weights_count + 1;
        end
        
        if (count == 2253) begin
            flag_data_read = 0;
            flag_conv = 1;
            count = count + 100;
        end
    end
    
    always @(posedge clk)
    if (flag_conv) begin
        if (it == 0) begin
            r = 0;
            i = 0; j = C; k = 2*C;
            K1 = Filters[0]; K2 = Filters[1]; K3 = Filters[2];
            K4 = Filters[3]; K5 = Filters[4]; K6 = Filters[5];
            K7 = Filters[6]; K8 = Filters[7]; K9 = Filters[8];
            fb = Filters[9];
            
            Conv[it] = K1*Image[i] + K2*Image[i+1] + K3*Image[i+2] + K4*Image[j] + K5*Image[j+1] + K6*Image[j+2] + K7*Image[k] + K8*Image[k+1] + K9*Image[k+2] + fb;
            
            if (Conv[it] >= max_value) Conv[it] = max_value;
            else if (Conv[it] < th) Conv[it] = alpha * (Conv[it] - th);

            it = it + 1; i = i + 1; j = j + 1; k = k + 1;
        end
        else if (it == 900) begin
            flag_conv = 0;
            flag_max = 1;
            it = 0;
        end
        else begin
            if (i > (r + 1) * C - 3) begin
                r = r + 1;
                i = r * C;
                j = (r + 1) * C;
                k = (r + 2) * C;
            end

            Conv[it] = K1*Image[i] + K2*Image[i+1] + K3*Image[i+2] + K4*Image[j] + K5*Image[j+1] + K6*Image[j+2] + K7*Image[k] + K8*Image[k+1] + K9*Image[k+2] + fb;
            
            if (Conv[it] >= max_value) Conv[it] = max_value;
            else if (Conv[it] < th) Conv[it] = alpha * (Conv[it] - th);
            
            it = it + 1; i = i + 1; j = j + 1; k = k + 1;
        end
    end
    
    always @(posedge clk)
    if (flag_max) begin
        if (!it) begin
            r = 0; i = 0; j = R_M;
            
            temp = Conv[i];
            if (Conv[i + 1] > temp) temp = Conv[i + 1];
            if (Conv[j] > temp) temp = Conv[j];
            if (Conv[j + 1] > temp) temp = Conv[j + 1];
            MP[it] = temp;
            
            it = it + 1;
        end
        else if (it == 225) begin
            flag_max = 0;
            flag_final = 1;
            sum = 0; j = 0; t = 0;
        end
        else begin
            if (i > (r + 1) * C_M - 2) begin
                r = r + 1;
                i = r * R_M;
                j = (r + 1) * R_M;
            end
            
            temp = Conv[i];
            if (Conv[i + 1] > temp) temp = Conv[i + 1];
            if (Conv[j] > temp) temp = Conv[j];
            MP[it] = temp;
            if (Conv[j + 1] > temp) temp = Conv[j + 1];
            
            it = it + 1;
            i = i + 2;
            j = j + 2;
        end
    end
    
    always @(posedge clk)
    if (flag_final) begin
        if (t == 10) begin
            flag_final = 0;
            flag_prob = 1;
        end
        else if(j == 225) begin
            Final[t] = sum + Bias[t];
            sum = 0; j = 0; t = t + 1;
        end
        else begin
            if (j) sum = sum + (MP[j] * Weights[225 * t + j]);
            else sum = MP[0] * Weights[225 * t];
            
            j = j + 1;
        end
    end
    
    always @(posedge clk)
    if (flag_prob) begin
        max = 0;
        if (Final[1] > Final[max]) max = 1;
        if (Final[2] > Final[max]) max = 2;
        if (Final[3] > Final[max]) max = 3;
        if (Final[4] > Final[max]) max = 4;
        if (Final[5] > Final[max]) max = 5;
        if (Final[6] > Final[max]) max = 6;
        if (Final[7] > Final[max]) max = 7;
        if (Final[8] > Final[max]) max = 8;
        if (Final[9] > Final[max]) max = 9;
        
        A = 0; A[max] = 1;
        flag_prob = 0;
    end
endmodule
STAGE 2

Generate the module

InputThe generated Stage 1 specification plus the required top-module name rtlpp_08062.
InstructionImplement the complete synthesizable RTL module from the generated specification.

Protocol summary; the Stage 2 runner creates a fresh prompt.

OutputReconstructed complete RTL module.
Stage 1 output → abstraction gate → fresh Stage 2 input. The intermediate text is generated separately for each model/attempt. It is not a prefilled golden description. Stage 2 receives neither the clean RTL nor the Stage 1 conversation.

Private final evaluation

Reference RTLClean RTL in the imported source record; hidden from Stage 2.
Score / oracleBinary formal equivalence to the hidden clean module

The formal oracle consumes the complete Stage 2 RTL file and compares it with the clean reference. A golden RTL file is scoring material, not a generated Stage 1 output.
